audit_type: Same-author adversarial content review plus deterministic structure/source metadata checks; not isolated or blind A/B review.
lexical_method: Lowercase word-set Jaccard on vignette plus lead-in. Screening only; low similarity is not proof of originality. Related constructs were separately assessed by the author.

checks: Claim scope and explicit distinction of stipulated experiments from published findings
URL and SetID agreement, label identity and section presence
Displayed highlights revision date separate from DailyMed publication/update date
Full mechanism-section hash agreement with retrieved text
Indicated population and prior-therapy counts where relevant
Separate 7.1 assay-interference and 12.2 receptor-blockade evidence where needed

coverage.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts
coverage.scope: Targeted pharmacology and foundational-science supplement; not a standalone full-exam blueprint or whole-bank balance certification.

repairs_before_release: Replaced the initial cystinosis enzyme distractor with a transporter-restoration alternative.
Rebuilt assay-interference alternatives around real analytical mechanisms and added a purified-drug control to exclude a second explanation.
Replaced weak tyrosinemia alternatives with distinct real enzyme targets/actions.
Shortened the mutant KIT answer to reduce length cueing.
Assigned easy versus moderate difficulty with item-specific author rationales.
Preserved uncertainty for ganaxolone, ziconotide, difelikefalin, and the independent clinical contribution of angiopoietin-2 blockade.
Added primary FcRn salvage/degradation evidence and precise claim locators.
author_review_result: No unresolved material defect identified in the same-author review; independent production acceptance is not established.
limitations: No independent audit execution or numerical 10/10 score is asserted.
Absence of exact duplication does not establish universal semantic originality.
Retrieved-page hashes identify the reviewed snapshots; live source pages may subsequently change.
required_before_production: Fresh isolated Author execution with required tool allowlist and execution evidence.
Blind Auditor A and Auditor B under required context and model-family separation.
Evidence and decision gates accepted by deterministic TRUSTED_IMPORTER.
